func documentPath(_ window: AXUIElement) throws -> String? { nil }
func run(_ failSet: Bool, _ failReset: Bool) -> String {
    var calls: [Float] = []
    let why = focusedDocumentMismatch(pid: 999_999, want: "/a/note.txt", setTimeout: { _, t in
        calls.append(t)
        if t > 0 && failSet { return .failure }
        if t == 0 && failReset { return .failure }
        return .success
    })
    return why + " | resets=\(calls.filter { $0 == 0 }.count)"
}
let out: [String: String] = [
    "set fails": run(true, false),
    "reset fails": run(false, true),
    "both fine (no such process: no file shown)": run(false, false),
]
print(String(data: try! JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: out, options: [.sortedKeys]), encoding: .utf8)!)
